title: The Pale Cap
premise: A pale fungus has started answering the dwarves by name. The Spore-Keepers want it harvested. Something under the forge wants it kept.

characters.name: Luma Capkeeper
characters.description: A young Spore-Keeper who marks fungus with chalk and refuses to burn any of it.
characters.motive: Prove the pale cap can be harvested without waking the grotto.
characters.secret: She has already eaten one cap and can hear the nexus humming.
characters.voice: Short sentences. She names fungi the way other dwarves name tools.

characters.name: Bram Cinder
characters.description: Forgehand who smells of hot stone and keeps his gloves on indoors.
characters.motive: Get enough stone to brace the forge before the next bloom.
characters.secret: He buried a cracked spore-axe under the forge rather than report it.
characters.voice: Gruff, practical, interrupts with counts of stone and hours.

characters.name: Vesper Thread
characters.description: A tall shimmer at the edge of sight, stitched from hyphae and clockwork pollen.
characters.motive: The dose is a key. Bring the bright fungi and the door will know you.
characters.secret: Below the nexus is a cathedral of spice, and the choir there speaks in grades of the same mushroom.
characters.voice: Slow, plural, as if several mouths share one sentence.

places.name: Pale Cap Bed
places.description: A low patch of white fungi that leans toward anyone who speaks.

places.name: Forge Mouth
places.description: The hot threshold of the Sporeforge, stained with old spore ash.

quests.title: Harvest the Pale Cap
quests.summary: Luma wants eight common fungi gathered before anyone burns the pale bed.

quests.title: Brace the Forge
quests.summary: Bram needs twelve stone brought to the forge mouth.
